shortThesis: Real civic-letter build, but demand and official coverage remain unproven.

thesisCurrent.summary: CivicState is a research-stage civic communication utility that turns resident issues into researched, citation-backed letters to officials.

adoption.note: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12 [evidence: worker brief instruction]; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read existing planning files and master plan
Inspected API, worker, frontend, and Prisma implementation files
Tagged repo-backed claims as evidence and external/market claims as assumptions

customerDefinition.primary: United States residents with a specific civic concern who need research, routing, drafting, and delivery help.
excluded: Organization/API buyers before individual workflow validation
customerDefinition.label: [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; MASTER_PLAN.md]

marketSizing.method: Bottom-up demand-unit ladder; no external TAM claimed.
scenarios: 100 paid submissions per month x $11.50 ASP = $1,150 monthly gross revenue [assumption: validation target and tier mix]
1,000 paid submissions per month x $11.50 ASP = $11,500 monthly gross revenue [assumption: initial serviceable scenario]
10,000 paid submissions per month x $11.50 ASP = $115,000 monthly gross revenue [assumption: venture-question threshold]
marketSizing.quality: assumption-led until paid usage and acquisition data exist

inputs: 100 paid submissions per month [assumption: validation target]
$11.50 average selling price [assumption: 50% single, 35% three-official, 15% full-spread mix]
$0.75 non-Stripe variable cost per job [assumption: placeholder without invoice data]
2.9% plus $0.30 payment processing [assumption: planning estimate, not live Stripe export]
financialModel.revenueBuild: 100 x $11.50 = $1,150 monthly gross revenue [assumption: arithmetic from modeled tier mix]

competition.name: Resistbot
competition.claim: Closest low-friction constituent message alternative [assumption: existing soul category claim, not web-verified]

competition.name: Change.org
competition.claim: Petition-hosting alternative [assumption: existing soul category claim, not web-verified]
competition.civicStateWedge: Individual official letters rather than public petitions [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md]

competition.name: Quorum / VoterVoice
competition.claim: Organization-grade advocacy platforms [assumption: existing soul category claim, not web-verified]

holes: No paid conversion evidence [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md says validated none]
Local officials integration is a stub [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/officials/cicero.ts]
Federal officials may lack deliverable emails [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/officials/congress.ts]
Frontend and API pricing tier names mismatch [evidence: apps/web/components/wizard/letter-preview.tsx and apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts]
mitigations: Run concierge paid validation before fundraising [assumption: validation plan]
Evaluate one local officials provider and measure coverage by ZIP [assumption: validation plan]
Fix tier naming and verify checkout-webhook-delivery path [evidence: roadmap item in ROADMAP.md]
residualRisks: Government inbox placement may stay below 85% [assumption: threshold from .planning/PROJECT.md]
Users may not pay above 3% conversion [assumption: threshold from .planning/PROJECT.md]
Compliance review may require narrower scope than the current product promise [assumption: legal risk, not legal advice]

assumptionLedger.assumption: Individuals will pay for researched civic letters.
assumptionLedger.validation: Track paid conversion during manual and self-serve tests.
assumptionLedger.killCriteria: Qualified visitor payment conversion stays below 3% [assumption: threshold from .planning/PROJECT.md]

assumptionLedger.validation: Measure delivered, bounced, spam complaint, and reply events.
assumptionLedger.killCriteria: Inbox placement remains below 85% [assumption: threshold from .planning/PROJECT.md]

assumptionLedger.validation: Record federal, state, and local matches by ZIP.
assumptionLedger.killCriteria: Local coverage remains below 60% after provider integration [assumption: threshold from .planning/PROJECT.md]

goToMarket.primary: Operator-led validation followed by compliant opt-in SEO pages.
goToMarket.secondary: Social sharing only after public campaign pages pass compliance review.
goToMarket.label: [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md and MASTER_PLAN.md; assumptions noted in BUSINESS.md]

roadmapBuildableShape.items: 8 checkbox items, each single-worker-sized and traceable to BUSINESS.md headings [evidence: ROADMAP.md]

honestyLabels.evidence: Repository, planning, implementation, or worker-brief evidence inspected locally.
honestyLabels.assumption: External market, legal, competitor, pricing-cost, or demand claim not verified in workspace-only mode.

freshness.externalClaims: must be revalidated before investor use
